question: Which of the following types of computer is used in climate research and weather forecasting?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Supercomputers.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Supercomputers**__

 __
 
• A Supercomputer would be** used for weather forecasting.**
 
• **Supercomputers **are used to** forecast climate research, molecular modelling, and oil and gas exploration.**
 
• **Meteorologists** use them to do research on the atmosphere and worldwide temperature variation.
 
• Scientists use them for sub-atomic demonstrating, which gives them the opportunity to figure out the structures and properties of natural composites.
 
• They are also used to figure out the impact of wind and turbulence on a plane.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Mini Computers**__

 __
 
• They are **smaller in size, faster, cost lower than mainframe computers.**
 
• Minicomputers are IBM-17, DEC PDP-11, HP-9000, etc.
 
 
 
• **Microcomputers**__
 __
 
• They are the least powerful, yet the most widely used and fastest-growing type of computer.
 
• They are also called **portable computers.**
 
 
 
• **Mainframe computers**__
 
 
• They are those having large internal memory storage and a comprehensive range of software.
 
• They serve as a backbone for the entire business world.
